Merge qualified upstream main into current-capability job fix

Preserve both complete workflow additions and unchanged authorization code. The combined manager suite passes 115 tests. Retain exact candidate and actual-main upstream receipts, initial Linux/Windows job qualification, and the cross-repository continuation checkpoint. Require five new candidate checks and independent immutable review before merge.

workflows.content:
name: Verify access controls and code monitoring

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run check
      - run: npm run build
      - name: Check generated UI matches its sources
        run: git diff --exit-code -- src/ui.generated.js

  managed-mcp:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: integrations/mcp-manager
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm test

  managed-mcp-windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: integrations/mcp-manager
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm test

  upstream-qualification:
    name: Upstream qualification / ${{ matrix.os }} / Node 24
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: integrations/mcp-manager
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Install the exact manager SDK without lifecycle scripts
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Verify manager and qualification guards on this platform
        run: npm test
      - name: Compare real pinned upstream packages in disposable stores
        run: npm run qualify:upstream
        env:
          MTERM_DISPOSABLE_UPSTREAM_QUALIFICATION: '1'
          MTERM_QUALIFICATION_CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - name: Verify tracked source remains unchanged
        if: always()
        run: git diff --exit-code
      - name: Preserve exact qualification and contract evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
        with:
          name: upstream-qualification-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/mterm-q-*/reports/
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn

notes: Commit, run and job response objects are the unmodified parsed JSON returned by GitHub API fetches.
PR identity fields retain original connector field names and values; this tool normalized GitHub metadata before returning it. The full tool response remains in the hashed source capture.

Workflow content is the exact returned text from the immutable-ref contents request. The connector returned decoded file content rather than the REST base64 envelope. Recompute Git blob and SHA256 from this text and bind the request URL/ref to the candidate or main commit.
Source capture filenames are relative to accounting-evidence. No new network calls or original-capture rewrites were made while preparing these identity inputs.
Display text, PR body and user fields are omitted from the PR identity projection; no identity field was synthesized from a normalized delivery receipt.
